//: Traffic and roadworks. Trips are generated per traffic cell (cellSize × cellSize tiles) from the buildings in it, using hourly curves (relative weights per hour, normalised in data.ts), and assigned to the road network with congestion-aware shortest paths. Link travel time follows the BPR function t = t0 × (1 + alpha × (v/c)^beta), with v/c capped at maxRatio. An assignment round processes origin cells a slice per tick (up to nodesPerTick settled road tiles, at least one origin) and finishes by blending the new flows into the saved flows (blend = share of the new round). Flows are in passenger car units (PCU) per hour; road capacities and speeds live in roads.json. Road class lane-closure capacity and the closure used for emergency repairs are in roads.json too.
